name: duopore-public-client-report-commitments
description: See which client report tasks are still open, late or missing from your plan.

interface.longDescription: See which client report tasks are still open, late or missing from your plan. Share task labels, due dates, status and links to your own measure references. Get a dated list of open work and late deliveries. Use reference codes, not private client details. This checks your updates; it does not save a task system, send reports or contact clients.
defaultPrompt: Which client report commitments are overdue?
Review these report tasks and flag work delivered late.
